decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (GT D057 - 01, 02 and 03 received 14th February 2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The approved outbuilding shall be constructed with red sandfaced facing brick work and have a red concrete interlocking tiled roof.

Condition : 4 - The approved outbuilding shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the existing dwelling on the site and shall not be used as separate living accommodation or for business purposes.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
